Write the article here, in Markdown. Start directly with the first section; the
title, lede and author are added by the page.

## A first section

Each `##` heading becomes an entry of "In this article" at the top of the page.
Keep paragraphs short. Bold with **two asterisks**, links like
[our Stellar page](/networks/stellar) for pages of this site, or
[a source](https://example.com) for other sites.

- Lists start with a hyphen.
- Keep each item to one line when you can.

## A second section

A figure with a date reads better than a round claim: "54 wallets in four days
(October 26 to 29, 2026)" rather than "fast adoption".
